about_the_game:
In Puffin Parcel Post, your goal is to manage a growing postal network in a charming world where friendly puffins are your dedicated delivery crew. Each day brings a growing number of parcels to deliver, and it's up to you to place buildings strategically to keep up with demand. As you expand your network, you'll need to make smart choices about where to position post offices and other key structures to ensure efficient deliveries. In the demo, you can take a peek at one of the levels available in the full game.

As you progress, you’ll need to balance growth with efficiency, making the best use of your resources to keep your puffin-powered postal service running smoothly. To help you adapt, you can unlock a variety of unique perks and upgrades that introduce fresh twists to your strategy. Some might help your puffins work faster, while others could allow you to process parcels more efficiently or uncover new building synergies. Each run offers a chance to explore a new combination of upgrades, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same.

With its engaging gameplay set within a playful world, Puffin Parcel Post offers a roguelite experience full of discovery and replayability. Can you build a postal network that keeps up with the ever-growing demand, or will your puffins get overwhelmed by the flood of parcels?
